description: Source code for a test utility that scans directories and files for ID3 tags in MP3 files, including functions for hexdumping data, reading ID3 tags, and processing directories.

methods.name: hexdump
methods.description: Prints a hex and ASCII representation of binary data.

methods.name: scanFile
methods.description: Reads an MP3 file, extracts ID3 tags, and prints information including album art.

methods.name: scan
methods.description: Recursively scans directories for MP3 files and processes them.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point that initializes the environment and starts scanning provided paths.
